proof.coordinate_monotonicity: Fix every normal except one common or idiosyncratic increment. In the original equal-volatility GBM, increasing that increment increases every affected stock at subsequent monitoring dates, because its coefficient is nonnegative. Unaffected stocks and earlier dates are constant. Each monitored positive-weight basket and the arithmetic Asian average are therefore nondecreasing in that coordinate.
proof.one_threshold: If an unaffected monitoring date already violates the barrier the payoff is identically zero. Otherwise the intersection of all strict survival half-lines is itself a half-line, possibly empty or full. Within it the discounted call payoff is nonnegative and nondecreasing; at its finite endpoint it drops to zero. Original strict survival and digital ties are respected.
proof.total_variation: Survival at every contractual date bounds the date/asset average below H. Hence the discounted payoff is at most C=(H-K)exp(-rT)<40. Its coordinate variation is at most2C: at most C of monotone increase and at most C of knockout jump. Composition with the increasing normal quantile preserves this bound on the uniform coordinate.
proof.midpoint_quadrature: For a bounded-variation f and cell width w, let m be the midpoint. The left-half integral of abs(f(u)-f(m)) is at most (w/2) times variation on the left half, and similarly for the right half. Thus abs(integral_cell f-w*f(m))<=w*variation_cell/2. Summing cells gives at most w*TV(f)/2, including midpoint jumps. Define u=0,1 by one-sided limits; endpoint values have measure zero.
proof.product_telescope: Replace one independent continuous uniform coordinate at a time by the same midpoint grid. The variation bound is uniform in all fixed remaining coordinates, whether continuous or already discrete. Integrating each difference and applying triangle inequality gives price-law error <=number_of_normals*40/2^q discounted dollars.
proof.transfer_boundary: The proof requires exact independent scalar normal quantiles and exact continuous GBM/path/payoff arithmetic. Rounded inverse-CDF, native exp/clipping, barrier predicates and coherent loading need separate certificates. It does not certify the existing paired Box-Muller graph or provide a compiled circuit/runtime advantage.
